about: Le khasi lifundwa kuphela. Abakhethwa abathatha indawo bathatha isikhathi sokuphela esikhona. Izikhulu azikwazi ukugxuma, ukuhlehlisa, ukushintsha isikhathi, noma ukunweba isikhathi sokukhethwa ngale khasi.
appointed_scope: Izinkqubo zokuphetha ezibhalwe kule ndawo ngqo. Lezi zisebenzisa izinsuku zazo zokuqashwa.
appointment_settings: Ubude bokuqashwa obuhleliwe: bezomnotho {civil} zonyaka; zobulungiswa {judicial} zonyaka. Umugqa ngamunye ukhombisa ukuphela kwakho okubhalwe phansi.
choose_help: Vula noma iyiphi indawo bese ukhetha uhlelo lweZikhathi eduze kwesishayamthetho namamephu ayo. Ukuhlala kwakho akukuvimbeli ukuthi ubone iyiphi indawo.
clock_help: Usuku oluhleliwe luvela ekholweni lokukhetho oluhleliwe. Izilungiselelo zichaza isikhathi esihleliwe; azithathi indawo yezinsuku ezibhalwe phansi zesikhathi esihambayo.
elected_scope: Izikhathi ezisebenzayo ezihambisana nesishayamthetho esikhethiwe kule ndawo.
intro: Funda izikhathi ezibhalwe phansi nohlelo lokukhetho lendawo ekhethiwe.
no_legislature: Alikho isishayamthetho esibhalwe phansi kule ndawo.
no_refusals: Alikho ukwenqaba iholo elihambisana nale ndawo okubhalwe phansi.
no_terms: Alukho isikhathi esisebenzayo esibhalwe phansi kulokhu.
place_elected_scope: Izikhathi zokukhethwa ezisebenzayo ezibhalwe kule ndawo ngqo. Izindawo zabavoti zinamarekhodi azo.
refusal_scope: Lezi zingene zihambisana nale ndawo irekhodi lokucwaninga. Izinto ezingenayo indawo eqondile azikwazi ukubonakala kulokhu.
select_clock: Khetha isishayamthetho ukuze ufunde isikhathi saso sokusebenza nohlelo lokukhetho.
title: Ohlelo lwesikhathi
